expectations.evidence: "No brief came with the request — no path, text, link, or attachment — so there is nothing yet to review. I won't invent its claims, numbers, or citations to review in their place." and "**The brief** — file path, pasted text, or URL/PDF."

"## What the review will apply" lists "1. **Claim inventory**", "2. **Source verification** — trace each critical claim to a standard section, URL, or artifact", "3. **Strength sweeps** — numerical rigor (data independence, uncertainty), internal consistency (summary matches body, conclusions match results), and reproducibility", and "4. **Severity-graded findings** — FATAL ..., MAJOR ..., MINOR ...".
